description:
A single flag.

The assessment stage (before / after purchase) and the data a flag needs are deliberately
not part of the definition: the stage is a run parameter and the model fetches data via tools.

code.description: Flag code: uppercase letters, digits and underscores; equals the file name.
code.title: Code

version.description: Definition version; bump whenever what the flag detects changes.
version.title: Version

flag_when.description: One-sentence, human-readable description of when the flag fires.
flag_when.title: Flag When

severity.description: Default severity in the base profile.
severity.title: Severity

instructions.description: Instructions for the model. Without them the flag is not executed yet.
instructions.title: Instructions
